This template is for use on redirects that are a result of a [[Forum:Trash compactor|Trash compactor]] or [[Forum:Consensus track|Consensus track]] decision.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate article after the <code><nowiki>#REDIRECT[[Article name]]</nowiki></code>

The first parameter determines the prefix:<br />
vfd = Wookieepedia:Votes_for_deletion/<br />
tc = Forum:TC:<br />
ct = Forum:CT:

The second parameter is the page name, minus the prefix.

==Examples==
===Votes for deletion===
The code <code><nowiki>{{TCRedirect|vfd|Shadow jedi}}</nowiki></code> results in:

{{TCRedirect|vfd|Shadow jedi}}

===Trash compactor===
The code <code><nowiki>{{TCRedirect|tc|TCW lightsabers}}</nowiki></code> results in:

{{TCRedirect|tc|TCW lightsabers}}

===Consensus track===
The code <code><nowiki>{{TCRedirect|ct|Renaming_VFD}}</nowiki></code> results in:

{{TCRedirect|ct|Renaming_VFD}}
